messages:
frida_marketing: Quick callout  new product launch blog draft is live: https://docs.example.com/go-live-draft. Need quick passes on benchmark language, regional CTAs, JP/DE short copies, and inbound routing. Can we lock by tomorrow morning? :alarm_clock:

noah_growth: Ill own CTAs + A/B plan. Recommend two variants: Webinar-first vs Quickstart-first. Also will add GA event names: go_live.variant and go_live.cta.

jiro_pm: Benchmark source = internal bench-v3 on identical hardware. Current copy: "30% faster p99"  prefer "~30% lower p99 latency (internal tests)" and include a short methodology block.

celine_legal: Legal: avoid absolutes and superlatives. Suggested sentence: "Based on internal benchmark v3 comparing Redwood runtime to OpenModelX on identical hardware. Methodology: 3,000 requests; mixed sequence lengths; p99 measured across 5 runs." Replace "guarantee"/"industry-leading."

sam_ops: Ops routing snippet for playbook: `region_map = {"NA":"sales-na","EU":"sales-eu","APAC":"partners-apac"}`. Webinar capacity: EU slots Tue/Thu 10am CET, 40 seats -> auto-waitlist at 40. Also append UTM: `?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=go_live&utm_variant=A|B`.

frida_marketing: Thanks  pasted legal-safe sentence and methodology into the draft and softened superlatives. Link updated: https://docs.example.com/go-live-draft#v2. Noah: can you add JP/DE short copies (<=45 chars)?

noah_growth: JP webinar short = "" (will paste final in doc). DE webinar short = "Live-Demo: Jetzt anmelden". I'll add A/B config and GA tags.

celine_legal: LGTM after tiny edit: change "controlled tests" to "controlled internal tests" if that phrase appears. Otherwise legal sign-off.

jiro_pm: Updated benchmark phrasing to "~30% lower p99 latency (internal tests)." Pushed v3.

schedule-bot: Reminder: freeze window starts in 12 hours for publishing pipeline.

frida_marketing: If no objections by 9am tomorrow I'll mark copy locked and hand to ops to schedule. Thanks all :rocket:
